infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pulse uses the camera to capture a photo of a symptom (e.g. a rash or wound) for on-device visual triage. Images never leave your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pulse lets you attach an existing photo of a symptom for on-device visual triage. Images never leave your device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Pulse uses the microphone to capture your spoken symptoms for on-device speech-to-text. Audio never leaves your device.
